restart.note: images turned off and on again with the same topic; peak = 250 ms samples for 3 s after the first picture

memory.note: sum of PSS over all browser processes of the profile; peak = maximum of 250 ms samples from turning images on until the steady reading; steady = 25 s after the last new topic (text encoder released)

textFiltering.note: time until every paragraph within 2.5 viewports of long.html is analysed
